```{r}
# example from Vector Feild interpolation with RFB paper
VF_1 = function(v) c(v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2),1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1)
```


```{r}
euler_maryama=function(x0, fun, Q, step_size, n){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
  }
```

```{r}
divergence=function(x,y){
  
  grad_x=pracma::grad(VF_1_x, x0 = c(x,y))
  grad_y=pracma::grad(VF_1_y, x0 = c(x,y))
  
  grad_x[1]+grad_y[2]

}

div_vec <- Vectorize(divergence)
```

```{r}
data=list(c(0,0),c(-1,-1),c(-2,-1),c(-2.5,-.5), c(-3,2))

x1=c()
x2=c()
for(i in 1:length(data)){
  x1[i]=data[[i]][1]
  x2[i]=data[[i]][2]
}

```

```{r}
R=array(c(.1,0,0,.1), dim=c(2,2))

points=list(c(-1,1,0),
         c(-2.5,2,2),
         c(2,4,6),
         c(5,3,9))

x=list()
y=c()
t=c()
for(i in 1:length(points)){
  e=mvrnorm(1,mu=c(0,0),Sigma = R)
  #x[[i]]=c(points[[i]][1],points[[i]][2])
  x[[i]]=c(x1[i],x2[i])
  y[[i]]=x[[i]]+e
  t[i]=points[[i]][3]
}

```

```{r}
t
```


```{r}
Q=array(c(.2,0,0,.2),dim=c(2,2))
delta_t=.1
m=list(x[[1]])
P=list(Q)
m_hat=list()
p_hat=list()
F=list()
K=list()
I=array(c(1,0,0,1), dim=c(2,2))

#Forward pass
for(i in 1:(length(t)-1)){
  delta_t=t[i+1]-t[i]
  
  #prediction
  m_hat[[i]]=m[[i]]+VF_1(m[[i]])*delta_t
  F[[i]]=I+pracma::jacobian(VF_1,m[[i]])*delta_t
  p_hat[[i]]=F[[i]]%*%P[[i]]%*%t(F[[i]])+Q*delta_t

  
  #observer update
  K[[i]]=p_hat[[i]]%*%solve((p_hat[[i]]+R))
  m[[i+1]]=m_hat[[i]]+K[[i]]%*%(y[[i+1]]-m_hat[[i]])
  P[[i+1]]=(I-K[[i]])%*%p_hat[[i]]

}
```
